criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark field and light type on every frame; 9 the best, 1 and 5 hold. The hero is primitive on every frame. Frame 3 shows no readable floodwater, the comal stripe reads as door trim, no ledges. Frame 4's water reads as a shadow. Frame 6 nose on exposes the slab bumper and disc wheels. Frame 8's top 45 percent is dead black and the window car reads as a toy on a shelf.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One robotaxi, one world, comal only for the water line, the curb opening and closing, a dark value with no strobe, both devices working. Frames 5, 7 and 8 sit slightly outside the street frames.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. No false statement, but frame 6 to 7 implies 177 days dark while TPR's May 10th piece reported a return; frame 4's hook states as an event what the record frames as may; frame 9's airport quote is a statement inside Waymo's post.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The main points land with streets named. The action is thin: campaign 26E026 only in the first comment; no Texas body named; the rider stake implicit; the May to October service unclear.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover tension, frame 2 steps back, turn at 3, 4 to 8 build, 9 lands. Frame 7 retells a timeline and 8 repeats 5's count.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific and fair. Misses local flash flood knowledge; the close's line is more clever than actionable.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat. One object per day in 5 of the last 8 decks, a count as a field, and a San Antonio flood at night four days after no. 50.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 3 so the car is visibly in Salado Creek with brown rippled water and a lit limestone ledge, and add one line on frame 6 from TPR's May 10th piece that the service was set to return in May.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No floodwater; comal line reads as trim; black with blobs below; no bank.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Brown tinted rippled sheet at the beltline streaking the bank lamp; a lit limestone ledge behind.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat untextured dark quad reads as a cast shadow; ambiguous comal wedge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A mirror with a light ripple normal reflecting lamps and the wheel; comal a thin leading edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Nose on exposes the slab bumper and disc wheels under a floating body; no headlamps.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing about 30 degrees to the front quarter; seat the body with contact; low emissive headlamps.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Top 45 percent dead black; the window car reads as a toy on a shelf; generic books.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in so the monitor fills about half the frame height; stripe sodium light on the wall; drop the window car.
